environment.description: Kubernetes cluster running on EKS 1.27 with default namespace. Pod runs as a standard Deployment with no network policies. The IMDS endpoint (169.254.169.254) is accessible from pods. No egress filtering is applied. The service account has default token mounted. Pods run with default security context (non-root but no additional restrictions). Cluster uses Calico CNI with no GlobalNetworkPolicy applied.
